Chapter 309: Chapter 11 Perfect Seventh Stage, My Dao is Complete (Added Chapter, Asking for Monthly Votes at the Beginning of the Month)_2

It was merely because Lin Yuan had slightly manipulated the force of space.

…

“This is the place,” he said.

Near the permanent spatial rift on the Battlefield of Different Races.

Lin Yuan ceased any further approach.

Through constant trial just now, he had found this spot, which could significantly increase the speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force.

...

Any further and the speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force would not increase.

And being too close to the spatial rift, the surging spatial force would affect his own comprehension.

“Now the accumulation speed of the Door to the Myriad Realms is…”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes and felt it deeply for a moment.

“Approximately two hundred ninety-eight days to accumulate a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone.

Compared to the initial three hundred thirty-three days.

Two hundred ninety-eight days for a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force, had already improved the accumulation speed by ten to twenty percent.

In the short term, this extra speed might not be of great use.

But if you look at it over an extended period, it would be a considerable amount of World-Breaking Origin Force income.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, living tens of thousands to millions of years was easy, and over such a lengthy timeline, the increased accumulation speed would form a substantial advantage like a snowball effect.

Moreover.

This increase in the accumulation speed of the Door to the Myriad Realms’ World-Breaking Origin Force.

The biggest impact on Lin Yuan was not the ten to twenty percent increase in speed.

But it allowed Lin Yuan to see a second method of obtaining World-Breaking Origin Force.

Before coming to the Battlefield of Different Races.

Lin Yuan had thought that World-Breaking Origin Force could only be accumulated slowly at a pace of one strand every three hundred thirty-three days.

But now.

Lin Yuan knew that this permanent spatial rift could enhance the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force.

From this, he deduced a conclusion.

If Lin Yuan went to a larger permanent spatial rift.

Would the speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force continue to increase?

The current rift was merely ten meters long, but those medium and large alien battlefields had permanent spatial rifts that might span thousands of miles, even millions of miles.

Near such spatial rifts, could the speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force surge dramatically?

“No rush for now,” he said.

“Let’s wait until stepping into the Seventh Rank.”

Lin Yuan steadied his body, and accompanying his proximity to the permanent spatial rift, his comprehension of space rules was increasing at a terrifying speed.

Almost every half day or so, he could fully comprehend one kind of basic spatial model.

Based on the current rate of comprehending space rules, in five to six days at most, he would have fully comprehended nine hundred sixty-five kinds of basic spatial models.

Then.

Lin Yuan would be able to step into the Seventh Rank.

This Seventh Rank was not the ordinary sense of Seventh Rank.

If it were just an ordinary Seventh Rank, Lin Yuan would already have been at that rank back in the Immortal Tao World.

But Lin Yuan was somewhat dissatisfied with that kind of Seventh Rank, so he had been dragging it out until now.

The Seventh Rank Lin Yuan wanted to step into was one that perfectly matched Martial Tao, the Perfect Seventh Rank.

…

Time passed.

Before long, seven days had gone by.

On Chikun Main Star, in the Thirteen Peaks Great Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Silently.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

Strands of spatial force emerged.

They quickly converged into a kind of inverted pyramid spatial model.

Hum.

As this spatial model formed.

Lin Yuan’s understanding of space suddenly took on a certain completeness.

“Nine hundred sixty-five kinds of spatial models…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lowered, he muttered to himself, “All thoroughly comprehended.”

At this moment, his surroundings, in Lin Yuan’s eyes, almost had a translucent feel.

Having comprehended all the basic spatial models, Lin Yuan’s understanding of space rules had reached new heights, and his perception of space had developed its own uniqueness.

“That’s how it should be.”

“My Seventh Stage Martial Tao should be like this.”

“My path is complete.”

Lin Yuan was vibrant, with sufficient comprehension of space, the derivation of the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter was almost natural.

Just an hour later, Lin Yuan had derived the initial part of the Seventh Rank Chapter.

“Let’s break through now,” he said.

Lin Yuan did not hesitate much.

He had already experienced advancing to the Seventh Rank, and with such a high understanding of space and the aid of his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, breaking through to the Seventh Rank was almost guaranteed to succeed.

“Begin.”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes.

The breath within his body suddenly began to gather slowly.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Above, ten million kilometers away, a space slightly twisted.

Chikun Star Lord, dressed in a crimson robe and with his hands clasped behind his back, stood there quietly.

Not far away, twelve figures stood in succession—it was the twelve Peak Masters of Chikun Star Lord.

Aside from the junior disciple Lin Yuan, all twelve Peak Masters had appeared here, standing respectfully.

“Everyone is here.”

Chikun Star Lord glanced over the twelve disciples.

“Now, let me demonstrate for you just many applications of Space Rules…”

Chikun Star Lord said indifferently.

Although the virtual world can almost perfectly replicate everything from the outside world,

it still cannot perfectly replicate Space Rules.

Thus, every once in a while, Chikun Star Lord would gather all his disciples under the outer space, personally demonstrating the use of the power of space.

“Teacher, the junior disciple has not yet arrived…”

At this moment, the fourth Peak Master Zuo Ge couldn’t help but speak.

He had looked around for a long time and noticed that only the twelve of them were present; the junior disciple Lin Yuan was not there.

As soon as these words were spoken,

the fifth, sixth, and seventh Peak Masters also looked towards Chikun Star Lord.

They had also noticed this issue, but they didn’t dare to ask since Chikun Star Lord had not mentioned it.

“The junior disciple?”

Chikun Star Lord glanced at the fourth Peak Master Zuo Ge and the other Peak Masters who were still at the Sixth Rank.

The teachings they now received, Lin Yuan had essentially already comprehended.

The last time he demonstrated the space model, Chikun Star Lord noticed Lin Yuan’s understanding of Space Rules.

Therefore, he did not specifically call Lin Yuan this time, mainly wanting to save some face for ninth Peak Masters like the fourth Peak Master.

The thought of being surpassed by the youngest disciple after so many years of being a disciple… Chikun Star Lord thought about it and found it to be quite normal.

After all, given the talents displayed by Lin Yuan, surpassing from the fourth Peak Master to the twelfth wasn’t the issue,

It was just a matter of time.

“Alright.”

“Enough talk.”

Chikun Star Lord didn’t bother to explain.

“Next, I will try to materialize the Space Rules as much as possible, you all try your best to break through them.”

Having said this,

Chikun Star Lord’s figure disappeared from the spot.

This scene made the twelve Peak Masters on the scene tense.

Even the Great Peak Masters, who had long entered the Seventh Rank, had serious expressions,

the materialization of Space Rules mentioned by Chikun Star Lord, was definitely not a trivial matter.

Humm.

The next moment.

The twelve Peak Masters found that the space around them began to twist.

Their own figures became smaller and smaller, almost turning into mesons.

Above everyone’s heads, a massive entity appeared; it was a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, whose size was tens to hundreds of times that of a normal life planet.

Under the condition that the twelve Peak Masters’ figures were turned into mesons, the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun seemed even more like a splendid starry river, towering above and looking down at everyone.

“We can’t go on like this.”

The twelve Peak Masters trembled in spirit, realizing that if they didn’t resist, their mental states would be destroyed, and then they would definitely be scolded by the teacher again.

Thus, the twelve exerted their fullest strength in an explosion, seeking to resist the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun that seemed to crush down like the heavens.

But the next moment,

there was no longer a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun that resembled a splendid starry river between heaven and earth, the twelve Peak Masters’ figures also returned to normal, and the twisted space quickly calmed down.

However, the twelve Peak Masters did not dare to relax.

Because, unknown to them, their teacher Chikun Star Lord, had already come by their side, standing behind everyone, looking down at the Chikun Main Star below.

As if observing someone.

“Hm?”

The Great Peak Master, also at the Seventh-Rank Peak, likewise noticed something.

“Is this the aura of breaking through to the Seventh Rank? Junior disciple, is junior disciple breaking through to the Seventh Rank?”

The Great Peak Master muttered to himself, yet his voice rang in every Peak Master’s ear.

“Breaking through to the Seventh Rank?”

Fourth Peak Master Zuo Ge stared, dumbfounded and incredulous.

Chikun Star Lord glanced at the fourth Peak Master Zuo Ge and then at the other Peak Masters.

As if to say,

See?

Now do you understand why I didn’t call your junior disciple over?

The twelve Peak Masters were utterly bewildered.
